description: Stephanie calls Betty directly to exchange intelligence: Stephanie shares her updated market valuation framing (spending index at 48, city's 10% grant threshold confirmation that auto row is formally distressed) and asks Betty what she is hearing from auto row property owners about their hold-or-sell timelines. Stephanie makes clear — without a direct solicitation — that she is the right resource when auto row owners start asking real estate questions. Relationship reinforcement at trust 0.57.

resources.detail: Mutual professional intelligence exchange — no cash transfer

expected_outcome.from_agent_effect: Gains ground-level auto row business owner sentiment data; reinforces positioning as the market analyst most closely tracking auto row property values; keeps referral channel with Betty warm
expected_outcome.to_agent_effect: Receives updated market valuation framing and confirmation that the city policy action around auto row is being tracked by real estate professionals; may benefit from knowing a trusted agent is available when diner's own real estate situation requires advice

contingency: If Betty is unavailable or conversation is brief, Stephanie leaves a voicemail referencing the spending index data and the council's 10% threshold decision, and follows up by text.
